name: Iberpapel Gestión, S.A.
summary: Iberpapel Gestión, S.A., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sells paper products in Spain, rest of the European Union, South America, Africa, and internationally. The company offers cardboard, copystar, copyright, Eco+, Zcopy, GO, laser preprint, silk paper, sublimation paper, Ko offset paper, vellum SC, vellum TT, Zicubag, Zicubag GR, Zicubarrier FF, Zicuflex, Zicujet, Zicukraft, Zicupharma, Zicupharma HO, Zicusil, and Zicukraft Nature. It also manufactures and sells cellulose fibre; operates in printing and writing paper market; and engages in reforestation and forestry operations.
